run_visual_grounding_inference: run visual grounding inference on an image with a text query to locate objects
list_visual_grounding_models: list all available visual grounding model names with an optional wildcard pattern filter
visualize_grounding_results: visualize predicted bounding boxes on images and optionally save results to a directory
preprocess_grounding_inputs: preprocess image and text inputs by loading images and applying the test pipeline transforms
postprocess_grounding_preds: postprocess prediction DataSample objects and extract predicted bounding boxes into a results dictionary
